item.title: Self-Healing Test: Marrying Agentic AI with Playwright and GitHub Actions 🤖 🌐 🖥️
item.description: While fidling with the Agentic AI for a while I have tried to build a locator selfhealing Agentic AI. Every automation engineer has lived through the frustration of UI locator drift. A frontend update changes an element ID, reworks a component tree, or swaps an input wrapper, instantly breaking a test suite that was working an hour before. Rather than treating test fragility as a constant maintenance burden, we can embed Agentic AI reflection loops directly into the Page Object Model (POM) pattern.
